correctness.rationale: Independent two-edge inclusion-exclusion yields exact covariance values by four support patterns. Orthogonal elimination of deterministic margins and covariance action (Sigma A)_ij=(p+p²+nr+s)A_ij+s A_ji establish both eigenspaces, dimensions, positivity, uniqueness of the size-five scalar case. Full rational enumeration n=3..8 passed 3,771 checks; the proof handles arbitrary n.

value.rationale: The full covariance spectrum is a natural complete second-moment classification of conditioned permutation assignment statistics. Its two orthogonal modes characterize every score variance; exact deterministic directions correspond to row/column effects. The exceptional isotropic 11-dimensional n=5 case and its sharp uniqueness provide a structural tight-frame result and a meaningful boundary, rather than an arbitrary finite calculation.
